sections.label: Affordable healthcare and CHAS subsidies
sections.summary: MOH shared plans to improve access to affordable healthcare and give every Singaporean outpatient medical subsidy through CHAS.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MOH shared plans to improve access to affordable healthcare, and to give every Singaporean outpatient medical subsidy through the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS).

sections.label: Re-examining educating Singaporeans
sections.summary: Three MPs urged re-examining the approach to educating Singaporeans, and major changes like removing secondary school streaming were made.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Mr Ang Wei Neng, Mr Charles Chong and Mr Louis Ng urged a re-examination of our approach to educating Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: And so, with Singaporeans at the core of our policy considerations, we did not shy away from making major changes like removing streaming in secondary schools.

sections.label: Youth Conversations on perspectives
sections.summary: MCCY worked with other public agencies on Youth Conversations, where over 8,000 youths shared perspectives on topics including mental health and social inequality.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MCCY worked with other public agencies to conduct Youth Conversations, where over 8,000 youths came forward to share their perspectives on topics ranging from mental health to social inequality.

sections.label: Ministries combining expertise on challenges
sections.summary: Four Ministries came together on low-income families, MCI and economic agencies work on SME digital capabilities, and agencies partner on Industry Transformation Maps.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To address inequality, no fewer than four Ministries have come together to ensure that we deliver practical solutions to help low-income families in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To help businesses navigate the digital future, Minister Iswaran shared how MCI and the economic agencies are working together to raise the digital capabilities of our small and medium enterprises.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: These follow from initiatives like the Industry Transformation Maps, where Government agencies partner one another to drive enterprise growth, support worker training, and address regulatory matters.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In a complex world, combining our expertise, assets and strengths is the best way to overcome challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: And our Public Service has the will and ability to do this.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Our Nominated Members of Parliament (NMPs) who debuted this year deserve special mention.

sections.label: Merdeka Generation Package and universal schemes
sections.summary: During this Committee of Supply, some have asked for more universal and permanent schemes when considering the Merdeka Generation Package.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: When we consider, for example, the Merdeka Generation Package during this Committee of Supply (COS), some have asked for more universal and permanent schemes.

sections.label: Streaming changes and Minister Ong's explanation
sections.summary: Streaming changes are much welcomed, but Minister Ong Ye Kung explained there was a reason for that cow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Streaming changes are much welcomed but, as Minister Ong Ye Kung explained, there was a reason for that cow.

sections.label: Election timing and balanced Budget
sections.summary: The speaker does not know when the election will be, but the Constitution requires a balanced Budget over each Government term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Honestly, I have no idea when the election will be.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: But what I do know is that our Constitution requires us to maintain a balanced Budget over each term of Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Towards the end of each term, we have better clarity of the overall Budget and how it affords us the space to carry out strategic moves if we need them.

sections.label: Merdeka Generation Package and election Budget
sections.summary: The speaker says if this were an election Budget, the Merdeka Generation Package would not be left unbudgeted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Honestly, if this were an election Budget, you will not see us not budgeting for the Merdeka Generation Package here.

sections.label: Dominance, spending and prudence
sections.summary: A politically astute government would use its dominance to justify more spending rather than talk of prudence, balance, tradeoffs and possible GST increases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: A politically astute government would use this dominance and wherewithal to justify even more spending rather than still talk about prudence, about balance, about tradeoffs, possible Goods and Services Tax increases in the next term.

sections.label: False news erodes trust
sections.summary: False and fake news erode trust and confidence and undermine leaders and institutions, including Parliament.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We talk about false and fake news impacting perceptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: This is really not trivial at all because they erode trust, they erode confidence and, ultimately, they undermine leaders and institutions, including Parliament.

sections.label: Parliament relevance, trust and mandate
sections.summary: The speaker urges continued robust discourse and says only a relevant, trusted and respected Parliament will be afforded space and mandate to lead.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I urge you to continue in this vein and for the Government to be open as it has been to this robust discourse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: It is only if we, as a Parliament, can remain relevant, trusted and respected, will our people afford us that space and mandate to lead and chart the way forward.
